description: This project proposes a wireless charging system for electric vehicles to enable efficient and cable-free energy transfer, inspired by sustainable space technologies. It focuses on research and innovative design to support greener transportation
summary: This project focuses on developing a wireless charging solution for electric vehicles aimed at enhancing convenience and sustainability. It involves designing and implementing a space mission concept which explores innovative technologies to efficiently charge vehicles without physical cables. The approach leverages cutting-edge research in wireless power transmission, contributing to a greener future.
details: The wireless charging system is intended to reduce dependency on traditional charging infrastructure by enabling seamless energy transfer using electromagnetic fields. This system aligns with NASA’s Space App Challenge themes by integrating space technology concepts and sustainable engineering solutions. The team has performed research and gathered relevant data to formulate a practical and scalable design.
